name: monopole
title: Monopole
description: Scores and judges your coding-agent sessions in CES, and proposes reviewed changes to your agent instructions.

prerequisites.purpose: Supplies the Python and the locked packages Monopole runs with.

actions.name: status
actions.title: Status
actions.description: Prints Prompting Time's status format 2: whether runs are running, the providers a recent check found signed out, and the newest 50 runs that are not drafts. Reads files only.

actions.name: runs
actions.title: List runs
actions.description: Prints the newest runs as JSON, with each run's session, judges, mean rating, failure cause, and how its proposal compared with the current instructions. Reads files only.

actions.name: run
actions.title: Show a run
actions.description: Prints one run as JSON, given --item <run id>: its card, selection, stages, rubric ratings, and models. Reads files only.

actions.name: delete
actions.title: Delete run
actions.description: Deletes a run that is not running from Monopole's run database, with its saved judge calls and events. Its Scores in CES stay.

actions.name: providers
actions.title: Last provider check
actions.description: Prints the last provider sign-in check as JSON. Reads files only.

actions.name: check-providers
actions.title: Check providers
actions.description: Checks whether Claude, Codex, and Devin are signed in with their status commands, and whether the W&B and OpenAI keys work with GET /models. Calls no model and spends nothing.

actions.name: save-settings
actions.title: Save settings
actions.description: Checks the changed settings and saves them in Monopole's state folder.
